Wide 3:1 panoramic pixel-art image, flat orthographic SIDE VIEW, transparent RGBA background. Draw only medium-distance buildings and factories, with proper crisp visible blocky pixels and simple coherent forms. The foreground elsewhere uses gunmetal steel walls, gray-brown concrete, rust and yellow sand. This middle layer must match that subdued neutral industrial palette, NOT navy blue.
COLOR AND BRIGHTNESS: weathered steel #343b3e, dusty concrete gray-brown #4a4b44, shadows #292f31, subtle rust #60503e. Medium-low contrast; no pitch black outlines, no silver bright rims, lit windows tiny and dim ochre #8b764e, at most a few dull cyan #657d7b. Keep all material highlights subdued, quieter/darker than a foreground sunlit yellow sand path. No blue wash, no luminous neon flood, no sunset gold.

Leftmost and rightmost 12px wide strips fully transparent; no clipped buildings at image edges. Bottom below base y180 entirely transparent, no ground, no terrain or continuous foundation.
Medium detail industrial facades: window grids, muted vents, pipes, roof beams; detail coarser than photoreal textures, larger forms than distant skyline, less foreground clutter.
